protocol: Replay the four captured width-four layers with the same five pinned workers and expert jobs. Compare a reserved caller with one that claims only first-pair jobs before the same early callback. Check captured, empty and complete prefixes, callback count, exact output, guards and affinity. Measure first-pair readiness and full retirement separately for each format, using five eligible samples per process across three independent pairs with reversed order in the second block. A format advances when readiness improves in at least two pairs with a paired geometric mean below one and geometric mean full retirement time at most equal to the control. These CPU-only timings exclude GPU submission and overlap.
